section: Science (Paper-2) · Ch — Force, Pressure & Motion — Deep 5
subject: Science
stem: A magician pulls a tablecloth quickly from under dishes without disturbing them much, because the dishes tend to remain in their state of rest unless a net force acts on them. This tendency of an object to resist a change in its state of motion is called:
explanation: Inertia (Newton's first law) is an object's natural resistance to a change in its state of rest or motion — a heavier object has more inertia, which is why the quick pull doesn't move the dishes much.
